info.title: Step CA API
info.description: Connect to hosts with short-lived SSH certificates from a smallstep step-ca server.

bearerAuth.description: Session token sent in the Authorization header as Bearer and the token.

cookieAuth.name: jwt
cookieAuth.description: Session JWT cookie set at sign-in. When present, it takes precedence over the Authorization header.

apiKeyAuth.description: API key sent in the Authorization header as Bearer and the key, which starts with tmx_. It acts as the key owner and cannot act as anyone else.

get.summary: OIDC callback for a Step CA sign-in
get.description: Public. The redirect URI registered with the identity provider behind the CA's OIDC provisioner. Exchanges the code, has the CA sign the key and tells the terminal to reconnect.

200.description: Signed in; an HTML page the browser can close.

400.description: The sign-in failed or is no longer active.
